name: Fireworks Training API
desc: API for writing your own RL or fine-tuning loops
desc_zh: 让你自己写强化学习或微调训练循环的 API
solves: Custom training needs a GPU cluster and a DevOps team; the Training API runs the loop while you write Python.
solves_zh: 定制训练要有 GPU 集群和运维团队，Training API 替你跑循环，你只写 Python。
best_for: You want a model tuned on your own verifier before next month's launch.
best_for_zh: 想在下个月上线前，用自家验证器调出一个专属模型。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — vendor's own site (channel D) (https://fireworks.ai/blog)）。 Generally available on 2026-08-31; the article says access before that was limited to a select group of organizations.
